rule: a word maps to a band only when every severity level the project definitions tie it to lies in that one band
sources: contracts/incident_extraction_prompt.txt SEVERITY_LEVEL rubric (= the ground-truth Severity Guide)
supabase finals get_incident_dashboard bands; dashboard/domain/charts.ts SEVERITY_LABELS

minimal.evidence: rubric level 1 name "Minimal / Very Low"; mapSeverity minimal -> 1

minor.evidence: rubric level 2 definition "Minor harm or limited danger ... minor injuries" and examples; level 1 examples "minor verbal disagreement", "minor incident with no injury"; not used for levels 3-5 (added in v2)

severe.evidence: rubric level 4 definition "Severe harm ... severe injuries"; mapSeverity severe -> 5

unmapped.serious: spans bands: rubric level 2 "not seriously threatening", level 3 "serious harm", level 4 example "serious assault"
unmapped.significant: spans bands: rubric level 3 "Significant harm", level 4 "significant danger"
unmapped.mild: not used by the severity definitions
unmapped.major: the rubric uses it only at levels 4 and 5 (one band), but it is not mapped: owner instruction of 2026-11-03 limits this change to minor
unmapped.extreme: the rubric uses it only at level 5 ("Extreme or catastrophic harm"), but it is not mapped (same instruction)
unmapped.catastrophic: the rubric uses it only at level 5, but it is not mapped (same instruction)

replacement: "<band>-severity" when group 3 matched, else "<band>-severity " (the separator becomes one space)
